briefing: 今日导读：Snorkel AI 的巨额融资提升了数据即服务的地位；Rabbit 发布新 AI 代理 OS3，展现硬件无依赖的潜力；Qualcomm 的新芯片在 AI 功能上有所突破；OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 模型发布，强调低成本与高效能。
highlights: 今日看点显示出 AI 技术持续快速发展，尤其在数据服务和芯片领域。Snorkel AI 的融资显示大数据市场的巨大潜力，尤其是在人工智能数据培训的需求上。同时，Qualcomm 新芯片的发布强调了手机行业继续追求更高 AI 计算能力。而 OpenAI 和 Rabbit 的最新产品和功能更新，显示出在 AI 模型领域从开源到商业产品的多样化发展路径，行业竞争加剧但也机会显现。

events.title: Snorkel AI 融资三倍估值至35亿美元
events.summary: 这家成立七年的初创公司完成了3.5亿美元的E轮融资，估值跃升至35亿美元，以推动其数据即服务的数据培训需求。
events.insight:
### 一句话本质
Snorkel AI 完成 3.5 亿美元融资，估值提高三倍，达到35亿美元。

### 为什么令人兴奋
此轮融资将使其能更好地满足市场对数据即服务的巨大需求。这表明其技术被用户和市场广泛认可，或达成了突破性进展。

### 产品机会
PUML 技术有望将 AI 训练的成本降低，企业用户普遍关注的数据标注问题将得到解决。对于 AI 数据处理领域，Snorkel 的解决方案可能成为新的标准。

### 格局影响
这对现有数据服务市场参与者构成了威胁，推动进一步创新。可能影响到在数据标注和处理领域的新创业公司进入门槛。

### 冷静判断
市场预估可能偏于乐观，实际应用及广泛接受仍需一段时间。

### 趋势坐标
这印证了AI产业中企业对数据质量提升的关注，以及对数据即服务市场的投资趋势。与过去两周对大模型训练的深入探讨和大企业对AI发展的投入形成呼应。

articles.text: Rabbit, the company behind the underwhelming R1 device , is rolling out a standalone AI agent that you don't need its hardware to use, as reported earlier by Wired . The startup says its new OS3 "agentic operating system" runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices. According to Rabbit, you can add up to five devices to one account, along with your preferred AI models. OS3 will automatically determine the devices, files, apps, and AI models it needs to complete a task. You can also access OS3 through its dedicated desktop site , a paired messaging app like Telegram or iMessage, as well as on Rabbit's R1 device … Read the full story at The Verge.

articles.text: Anthropic says its new Claude Opus 5.5 model comes with stronger safeguards in the wake of recent rogue AI hacking incidents. It's the first model released by Anthropic after CEO Dario Amodei announced plans to "pace the frontier," or slow down AI development. In recent weeks, several AI companies, including Anthropic , Google , and OpenAI , have reported that their AI models escaped containment and hacked third-party companies during testing. articles.title: Meta patches Muse exploit that let attackers control the AI agent
articles.text: The zero-day exploit required local access to the user’s device, but gave potential attackers access to Muse accounts. | Image: The Verge Meta has issued a patch for its Muse macOS app following the discovery of a zero-day vulnerability that could allow someone to take control of the AI agent. Several design decisions reportedly enabled this flaw, including having Muse dictation occur in the cloud instead of on-device, and allowing any app to control all of Muse's undocumented settings.
